findings.title: Stop before activation when the contract check fails
findings.body: The newly added contract check, package test, and activation journey are separate shell commands with no `set -e` or `&&` chaining. If manifest/schema validation fails, the shell continues to `npm test` and then activates the plugin, contradicting the stated requirement that contract and behavior checks pass before activation. Make this fence fail fast (for example, add `set -e` or chain the commands).

overall_explanation: The documented pre-activation contract gate does not actually prevent the activation command from running after a failed validation.
